name: Database (SQLite)
summary: A real database in one file, with simple add / find / search / update / delete. Handles lots of records on old computers. New fields can be added later without losing data.
use: db = DB('app.db'); people = db.table('people', name='text', age='int'); people.add(name='Amina', age=12)

points.note: Makes the table the first time; later runs reuse it.
Fields you add later are added to existing databases, so old data isn't lost.
